tools.name: get_contact
tools.description: Return FIOR Law Firm email, phone, office addresses, map links, and contact page. Use when the user wants to reach the firm. Does not send email.

tools.name: get_practice_area
tools.description: Return the title, intro, and URL for one practice area by English slug (for example trade-and-investment-law).

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: List the main public English pages of FIOR Law Firm (home, about, practice areas, team, publications, careers, contact). Other locales are at /tr/, /de/, and /ja/.

tools.name: list_practice_areas
tools.description: List FIOR practice areas with slug, title, and URL path. Use when the user asks which legal fields the firm covers.

tools.name: list_publications
tools.description: List published articles with slug, title, date, and URL path. Use when the user asks for FIOR publications or legal notes.

tools.name: list_team
tools.description: List FIOR lawyers and their titles. Use when the user asks who works at the firm.

tools.name: navigate_site
tools.description: Navigate this tab to a public FIOR Law Firm page. Use a site-relative path such as /contact or /practice-areas/trade-and-investment-law. Localized paths use /tr/, /de/, or /ja/.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Search public pages, practice areas, publications, and team names. Use when the user is looking for a topic, lawyer, or article.
